data.name: Lurks Beneath
data.detailed_description:
A TRUE CRIME SIMULATOR — VOLUME I

You are Detective Partridge, investigating the disappearance of a missing girl at a run-down trailer park at the end of a gravel road. Piece together the mystery of what happened to Abbey Pullman by cross-examining the residents of the trailer park and searching for clues.

TALK LIKE A DETECTIVE

Type your own questions. Investigate how you want. There are NO dialogue trees. What they will tell you, what they will deny, and what they emotionally cannot face yet are all subject to change. Push them with evidence you find, or inconsistencies in their stories. Watch composure crack or earn trust.

They do not recite scripts. They hold secrets. And they will not say what they do not know. Investigate the crime by asking the characters ANYTHING you want, just like a real detective. 

INVESTIGATE LIKE IT MATTERS

The environment of the trailer park holds secrets to discover just as much as the characters do. Learn as much as you can to confront the characters with evidence and expose the truth of what happened to Abbey Pullman. 

THE SUSPECTS:

Chuck Pullman: a father who will not leave his campfire until his daughter comes home. 

Daisy Brichard: the sweetest grandmother imaginable, baking for when Abby gets back. 

Desmond Lloyd: a paranoid man nobody believes. He may be right about everything.

Made by Morph

.

Note: This game contains generative AI in the form of NPCs being able to respond to the user's actual input and questions. The game loads a local, offline, LLM (Llama 3.1 8B), and when you interact with the NPC characters, there is a combination of code architecture and LLM interaction that makes each response unique and perfectly in line with story lore. Generative AI was not used to create the game, but is used as a gameplay mechanic.

data.short_description: Investigate a little girl's disappearance at a rundown trailer park. Play as Detective Partridge and cross examine three suspects to find the truth with fully freeform interrogation. Type anything and ask anything you want.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 6GB / AMD RX 5600 XT (Vulkan support required)
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Native
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 12GB / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Native

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14 (Sonoma)
  • Processor: Apple M1 (Apple Silicon only — Intel Macs not supported)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or equivalent
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Native
  • Additional Notes: Game includes a bundled local AI language model — nothing runs in the cloud. Response speed depends heavily on your hardware. Below minimum specs, responses may take 20+ seconds and the game is not enjoyable.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15 (Sequoia)
  • Processor: Apple M2 Pro / M3
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 Pro or equivalent
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Native
  • Additional Notes: Game includes a bundled local AI language model — nothing runs in the cloud. Response speed depends heavily on your hardware. Below minimum specs, responses may take 20+ seconds and the game is not enjoyable.

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores a story about a missing girl and the gruesome details that stem from that. Nothing is shown, but you discover the plot details through investigation.
